name: yakuphanycl-instinct
description: Self-learning memory for AI coding agents. Observes tool sequences, user preferences, and recurring fixes; confidence-based promotion (hits ≥5 → mature, ≥10 → rule) so agents stop repeating mistakes without explicit instruction. SQLite-backed, project-aware, zero external deps. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Goose, Codex. Published on PyPI as `instinct-mcp` and registered in the MCP Registry.
